units.characteristics: the overwhelming vision of God's glory that prostrates the seer
units.gist: the throne-chariot vision - the four living creatures, the wheels within wheels full of eyes, the crystal expanse, and above it 'the likeness of a THRONE... and seated above it a likeness with a human appearance'; 'such was the appearance of the likeness of the GLORY OF THE LORD. And when I saw it, I FELL ON MY FACE' - the encounter with transcendent glory that undoes and prostrates

units.characteristics: the word internalised (eaten, sweet though full of woe); the hardened face given; the cost of bearing it
units.gist: GEM - the commission to 'a REBELLIOUS HOUSE, impudent and stubborn'; 'be NOT AFRAID of them though briers, thorns, scorpions'; 'EAT THIS SCROLL' of 'lamentation and mourning and woe' - 'it was in my mouth AS SWEET AS HONEY' (the word internalised, sweet even in its bitterness); 'I have made your FACE HARD as their faces... harder than flint'; 'receive my words IN YOUR HEART'; 'I went in BITTERNESS... the hand of the LORD strong upon me', overwhelmed seven days

units.characteristics: the watchman's responsibility; delivering one's own soul by warning; the bound and mute prophet
units.gist: GEM - 'I have made you a WATCHMAN for the house of Israel. Whenever you hear a word from my mouth, you shall WARN them'; 'if you give no warning... his blood I will REQUIRE AT YOUR HAND; but if you warn... you will have DELIVERED YOUR SOUL' (accountability for warning others); then bound with cords and made MUTE, 'unable to reprove them', until God opens his mouth - the weight of the watchman's charge
